configs.name: Fault-Tolerant Anyonic Circuit & Noise Simulator
configs.description: Simulates Fibonacci and Majorana non-Abelian anyon braiding circuits under stochastic thermal noise and background magnetic flux fluctuation, evaluating dynamic gate fidelity and topological protection thresholds.

configs.name: Kibble-Zurek Quantum Criticality & Quench
configs.description: Executes continuous parameter sweeps across quantum critical points at variable rates to evaluate defect density scaling laws and test universality classes in high-dimensional topological matter.

configs.name: Non-Hermitian Skin Effect & Exceptional Point Tracking
configs.description: Simulates non-Hermitian dissipative Hamiltonians with complex energy spectra, mapping bulk eigenmode collapse onto boundaries and tracking exceptional point degeneracies.

configs.name: Holographic Thermalization & AdS Black Hole Ingestion
configs.description: Simulates bulk black hole horizon formation and scalar field collapse in AdS5 spacetime, tracking dual boundary CFT thermalization rates, Page curve evolution, and quantum scrambling dynamics.

configs.name: High-Dim Fractional Quantum Hall & PEPS Ingestion
configs.description: Supports direct ingestion of PEPS/MPS tensor network wavefunctions for live visualization of 2D/3D topological entanglement entropy in fractional quantum Hall states.
